# TE.BRA Sports Bar

> Cocktail and sports bar in Hersonissos, Crete. Every big match on the screens, cocktails, pool, darts, and great food. Open daily. 5.0 on Tripadvisor.

TE.BRA is a stylish sports lounge just off the main strip in Hersonissos. We show football, Champions League, and major live sport on multiple large screens, serve cocktails and bar food, and offer pool and darts. Reservations by WhatsApp: +30 699 339 9000.
